item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a firm bedtime and a wind-down practice in the evening, which is the right structure. Sleep quality is built hours earlier, though. Protect that window: dim the lights, put screens away, and let your mind finish its business before you lie down. Consistency matters more than any single perfect night. Tonight, start your wind-down routine on time and treat bedtime as a fixed appointment.
